visual_identity.core_identity: A colossal subterranean worm whose immense segmented body and circular tooth-filled maw define its identity.
visual_identity.silhouette: Huge cylindrical segmented body with the front dominated by a round open maw.
visual_identity.head_features: No separate skull; front is a circular muscular mouth ringed with inward-pointing teeth.
visual_identity.body_shape: Extremely thick worm body with repeated broad segments and no limbs.
visual_identity.surface: Large simple segmented plates or folds with minimal fine texture.
